MEASUREMENT-LIMITED.description: Överträdelse av isolationsavstånd/frigång ( frigång 0.0750 mm; faktisk 0.0000 mm)
MEASUREMENT-LIMITED.why: actual 0.0000 mm is at or below the front handoff's own registration_holdout_mm of 0.1029 (20.7-27.4 genuine px/mm). Actual 0.0000 mm means the two rows' MINIMUM-AREA RECTANGLES overlap. The segmentation reports SEPARATE connected components, so the blobs do not overlap; a rotated rect contains background, and the overlap is in the representation rather than in Apple's copper.

MEASUREMENT-LIMITED.description: Öppning i framsidans lödmask överbryggar objekt från olika nät
MEASUREMENT-LIMITED.inherits_from: the clearance violation on the same pair, which is MEASUREMENT-LIMITED
MEASUREMENT-LIMITED.why: KiCad reports a mask bridge with NO distance, so it carries no number of its own. It does not need one: a bridge between these two lands is the same physical fact as the clearance violation between the same two lands, and that one is measurement-limited. Inherited, and the inheritance is recorded rather than assumed.
